**Batch 89 authoring is complete:** 11 A-page items, one B-page example, both pages, the manifest, coverage ledger, proof contracts, cross-batch dependencies, source records, and 12 current Step 1 readiness records.

The current plan requires `csm-exact-models`, which the design summary omits; I kept it in the page requirements and recorded the discrepancy in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-89.notes.md). The assigned item levels are valid locally, from 0 through 5. All 12 readiness records are closed and ready; these record authoring readiness, not independent proof approval.

Scoped content, rendering, proof layout, contract, precheck, dependency, and source-fetch checks passed. Coverage has one documented low-yield advisory: 19 of 66 harvested results were scaffolded, with the other results explicitly dispositioned.

The full-run dependency checks remain owner blockers: other batches have empty inventories, and the shared batch-dependency snapshot needs recomputation after this manifest change. I left those shared files untouched; the exact findings are in the notes.

Key evidence: [A/B pages manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-89.pages.json), [coverage and source stamps](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-89.coverage.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-89.proof-contracts.json), and [cross-batch dependencies](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-89.cross-batch-dependencies.json).
